annotation.title_clean: Stakeholder Consultation on UNESCO AI Readiness Assessment Held Today
annotation.title_en: Stakeholder Consultation on UNESCO AI Readiness Assessment Held Today
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Communication, Digital Technology and Innovation, Ghana
annotation.venue: Ministry of Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations (moc.gov.gh)
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Ghana's Ministry of Communication reports a 11 March 2026 stakeholder consultation with academia to validate the UNESCO AI Readiness Assessment Methodology. The draft finds Ghana lacks binding AI-specific regulation and comprehensive data governance frameworks. Inputs will feed the national AI readiness report guiding AI governance recommendations. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Consultation validates Ghana's UNESCO AI-RAM draft report
Assessment covers policy, institutional capacity, infrastructure, data governance and ethical safeguards
Ghana lacks binding AI-specific regulations and comprehensive data governance frameworks
Academia's role in research, skills and critical analysis emphasised
Part of a series of engagements with government, academia and industry
